summary: "The History of Don Quixote, Volume 2, Part 24" by Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra is part of a novel originally published in two parts in 1605 and 1615. This work follows the adventures of Alonso Quijano, a hidalgo who loses his sanity reading chivalric romances and reinvents himself as the knight-errant Don Quixote. Accompanied by his squire Sancho Panza, Don Quixote mistakes windmills for giants and inns for castles, creating chaos as he attempts to revive chivalry in a world that has moved beyond it.
